description: This file defines the Vtiger_Mailer class, extending PHPMailer, providing an API for SMTP email sending, email templating, signature management, and queuing functionalities within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_Mailer
classes.description: A class extending PHPMailer, providing methods for email configuration, templating, queuing, and dispatching emails within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_Mailer_Listener
classes.description: Abstract class for handling email sending events such as success or error notifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the mailer instance and configures SMTP settings from the database.

methods.name: __getUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves a unique ID for queuing emails.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets SMTP server configuration based on database parameters.

methods.name: reinitialize
methods.description: Resets the mailer instance properties for a new email.

methods.name: initFromTemplate
methods.description: Loads email subject and body from a specified email template.

methods.name: addSignature
methods.description: Appends the user's signature to the email body.

methods.name: ConfigSenderInfo
methods.description: Configures the sender's email and name, as well as reply-to address.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends the email immediately or queues it depending on configuration.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Prepares and sends or queues an email to a recipient with optional template.

methods.name: __initializeQueue
methods.description: Creates email queue tables if they do not exist.

methods.name: __AddToQueue
methods.description: Adds the current email to the email queue in the database.

methods.name: dispatchQueue
methods.description: Processes and sends queued emails, triggering success or error events.
